protocol.primary_endpoint: Original development complete-group binding accuracy at 130000 online observations.
protocol.secondary_endpoints: Exact four-byte greedy answers, original/expanded train monitors, earlier-reader loss change from 10000 observations, live-loop cost and graph decoding.
protocol.comparison: All arms train from scratch on identical selected source bytes and observation/replay schedules. The associative and H512 selective arms share initial common weights. H588 selective has 104 more parameters than associative, controlling approximately for parameter count. Generated byte contents and recurrence differ. Seeds are paired, not shared trained ancestors.
protocol.timing: Separate prerequisite and successive declared endpoint live-loop segments, including replay, speech, logging and checkpoint writes; excludes setup and assessment. No concurrent GPU study processes.
protocol.limits: Three-seed comparison at 120000 binding observations. No hyperparameter search or selection by intermediate results. The assay uses two candidate answers and four-byte box/bag generation, not general language. The entire final stage is declared from birth; no replay stage is appended to extend exposure.
